scripts.predev: npm run build -w @dreamatic/design-agent && npm run build -w @dreamatic/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @dreamatic/server" "npm run wait:server && npm run dev -w @dreamatic/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dreamatic/design-agent && npm run build -w @dreamatic/cli && npm run build -w @dreamatic/server && npm run build -w @dreamatic/web
scripts.check: npm run check -w @dreamatic/design-agent && npm run check -w @dreamatic/cli && npm run check -w @dreamatic/server && npm run check -w @dreamatic/web
